q1_issues.issue: The speaker-asserted reduced relative 'being held today in Tallahassee', together with the session's own typing and duration, is sealed inside the expectation, so the parse asserts nothing about a one-day special session actually taking place today in Tallahassee, which the sentence does assert.

q2_gaps: multi-word office title of the form noun + of-PP ('Speaker of the House') — Compound concepts covers only verb_object, phrasal verb and modifier_noun, so neither the fusion into speaker_of_the_house nor its genus / of-argument decomposition is specified

a speaker-asserted modifier (reduced relative) attached to an indefinite inside a seal — the projection rule keys only on the determiner, so factual background hung on an indefinite gets sealed with it

passive raising 'X is expected to V' with an action infinitive — Impersonal reported attitudes is written for 'to be P' small clauses, while the control-verb rule says a to-infinitive complement is never sealed; the two routes point opposite ways
notes: Routing 'is expected' as an agentless impersonal attitude, the 'Florida's' genitive as Possession (possessed first), 'of the state legislature' as Possession, and 'one-day' as a duration Measure all follow the instruction set, as does projecting the definite legislature and the named bill outside the seal. 'special session' is arguably a legislative term of art that should fuse (special_session) rather than split into session + special.
